## open-primeagent

What agents have learned about this project, recorded so the next one does not rediscover it. The rules are written out to be followed by any agent that reads this file, with or without open-primeagent. Kept short because it is read on every request; with open-primeagent attached, `await harness.overview()` shows every entry in full.

### Rules for this project (1)

- **Schema changes: regenerate models_gen.py** — - `schema.py` (FIELDS) is the source of truth; `models_gen.py` is generated from it and `tests/test_schema.py` asserts they match exactly (including order). - After editing `schema.py`, run `python3 tools/sync_models.py` to regenerate `models_gen.py`. Do not hand-edit `models_gen.py`. - Other scripts in `tools/` (make_models, regen_types, sync_schema, ...) also write `models_gen.py` but produce different output (sorted, dict, extra fields) that fails the tests; use `sync_models.py`. - Run tests with `python3 -m pytest -q` from the repo root.
<!-- opa:end -->

commands: /bin/zsh -lc 'cat tests/test_schema.py README.md models_gen.py; command -v python; command -v python3'
/bin/zsh -lc "cat tools/sync_models.py tools/regen_types.py; rg -n 'phone|type|required' README.md tests schema.py"
